decisions.reason: The source changes where correct author photos are obtained, not the existing requirement to source article content from the publication website.
Providing the correct author-photo source does not change the requirement to remediate image quality with AI when necessary.
Correcting the author photo and identifying its source does not alter the magazine's polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style.
The author-photo correction does not change the digital flipbook deliverable or its scope.
The author-photo source correction does not change the deferred print-ready output requirement, its resolution, or its trim and bleed settings.
